in_marathi.name: Dhimahi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhimahi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dhimahi comes from the Sanskrit word 'dhima' which means deep meditation or contemplation. This name is associated with spiritual growth and inner wisdom. It is believed that those named Dhimahi have the ability to focus their minds and connect with the divine.
